scope: Separated incremental forecasting tests only. No new acquisition, cards, engine, simulations or coefficient adoption. Complete this batch and stop.
label: 四季已看過答案；回溯的時間資料外診斷，不是新盲測。

timeSplits.2023-24: No fitted evaluation: no earlier training pair available. Descriptive component stability only.
timeSplits.cutoff: Every predictor from the source season, never target-season tracking/rates/role/minutes. Known target MIN used only as evaluation weight/count exposure, never a predictor.

cohort: Same as prior talent study: source and target observed MIN>=100, valid source official OREB%, valid target outcome; target rate and OREB% in separate tasks. No deletion based on tracking availability. Missing indicators and train-only imputation. Rookie/no-history players not included.

features.chance: Source tracking OREB_CHANCES / source tracking MIN *36, a realized tracking opportunity rate, not starting location.
features.conversion: Source tracking OREB / OREB_CHANCES, if denominator>0 and numerator in[0,denominator]; otherwise missing and audited.
features.adjustedConversion: Source OREB/(OREB_CHANCES-OREB_CHANCE_DEFER), if denominator>0 and valid; exploratory only. Do not call deferrals box-out assists.
features.history: Source individual box OREB/36, official OREB% and log1p(MIN); OREB% outcome omits source OREB/36 to match previous baseline.
features.missingControl: History plus flags for missing chance and raw conversion only; no availability count containing hidden chance information.

models.persistence: Raw source box OREB/36 for rate, raw source official OREB% for pct.
models.missingOnly: history + chance/conversion missing indicators; negative control.

estimator.type: Linear ridge with unpenalized intercept, training-only median imputation, missing indicators and standardization. Same numeric procedure as prior study.
estimator.foldRule: SHA256(string playerID) modulo5; same person in same fold across all training years. Min weighted CV MSE, larger lambda on exact tie.
estimator.trainWeight: min(target MIN,1000), normalized mean1; all training targets precede source-season end of test.
estimator.predictionClip: rate>=0, OREB% in[0,100] percentage points. No test-season scaling or tuning.

metrics.rate: Target-minute-weighted MAE/RMSE of individual OREB/36; Pearson.
metrics.pct: Target-minute-weighted MAE/RMSE of official individual OREB%, percentage points; Pearson.
metrics.conditionalCount: Mean abs(rate prediction * given target MIN/36 - actual OREB); true exposure diagnostic, not minutes forecasting.
metrics.pool: Two forward-tested target seasons; equal season weights after within-season target-minute weighting. Pooled RMSE=sqrt(mean season MSE); pooled countMAE=mean season countMAE. Not a team-season game metric.

groups.movers: Different main team (maximum observed MIN) source vs target; grouping only, not causal trade estimate.
groups.both500: Both seasons MIN>=500. Groups with fewer than10 observations not estimated.

uncertainty.scheme: Paired franchise resampling crossed with player Poisson1 weights; common player/franchise weights across target seasons and all models. Equal-season normalization within each replicate. No simulation seeds exist; not engine adoption uncertainty. Training refit uncertainty excluded.
uncertainty.primaryFamily: Six primary rate-MAE comparisons: chance/conversion/both against each of persistence/history in 2025-26 all-player cohort. Bonferroni99.1667% intervals alongside95%. Other targets/seasons/groups exploratory.
uncertainty.jointLabel: 球隊＋球員聯合重抽；不是球隊＋模擬seed。

decision.supportedIncrement: Development-data candidate only if primary2025 rate MAE Bonferroni interval wholly negative against BOTH persistence and history, rate RMSE not significantly worse at95%; and2024 replication and movers show no significant MAE deterioration at95%. Does not authorize engine adoption.
decision.failure: If no primary candidate passes, report no verifiable incremental predictive value in current features. Do not choose adjustedBoth or a subgroup post hoc to evade this rule.
decision.noCausalClaim: Chance may encode role/environment and overlaps realized rebounds; good forecast does not identify box-out or participation causal coefficient.

descriptiveChecks: Exact OREB/36 from same tracking sample = chance36 * raw conversion where denominator positive; not additional information.
Reported raw/adjusted percentages versus count ratios: allow0.000501 rounding, list mismatches; never silently change raw records.
Missing/negative/invalid counts, duplicate IDs, tracked-minute coverage and per-model same cohort.
Three adjacent-pair opportunity/conversion/rate/PCT Pearson stability, including movers; >=500MIN sensitivity.
Track-vs-box OREB counts and MIN differences; no mixing denominators or asserting count identity across samples.
